title: Notification System
summary: Multi-channel message delivery with per-recipient inbox, read receipts and delivery status.

provenance.license: Proprietary — perpetual, transferable with written notice
provenance.notes: Retains SignalPost API conventions (/v1 base path, X-API-Key auth, snake_case payloads, vendor error envelope). Deliberately NOT normalized to house style — existing SignalPost client SDKs and vendor documentation must continue to work, and a future buyer expects the API they purchased. Adaptation is carried at the call site.

trade.notes: Resale permitted under the original perpetual licence. Support contract transfers only if the buyer assumes the SignalPost maintenance agreement before 2027-03-14.

retention.rationale: Already acquired; this confirms the position rather than opening a new purchase.

interface.conventions: snake_case payloads; vendor error envelope { error: { code, message } }

alias_endpoints.summary: Flat alias for POST /v1/messages; composes a pickup alert, defaults recipient to citizen. Still requires X-API-Key.
